facts.fact: Xalam Analytics estimates about 6 live commercial data centre facilities in Mozambique in 2024, leasing colocation space and power to third parties, with about 2.3 MW live IT load and Raxio the largest provider at about 50% share (document dated July 2025; no individual facility other than operators named).

note: Digital Realty iColo and Vodacom are said to be expanding with new Tier III facilities, but none is stated in service, so no tier3 fact.
